4046-4590-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have attacked 2 or more opponents this turn.
4046-4590-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
Repeat.

17-2226-2499.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
17-2226-2499.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lava Zombie by paying its mana cost.
When Lava Zombie enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1887-5231-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

880-2757-7893.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

129-1251-1409-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3000-4050-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3000-4050-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

586-5258-5618-5686-7183.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1456-4871-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1456-4871-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

480-2034-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3771-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
3771-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying at most {2} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
3771-5638-7070.notes: The starting cost can be reduced depending on the number of +1/+1 counters on Animar.

1978-2392-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat

934-1399-1606-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
934-1399-1606-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to it.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

509-1267-4883-5143.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-4883-5143.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-4883-5143.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

2232-6470-6751.notablePrerequisites: You control and own a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana.
2232-6470-6751.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve the Iridescent Tiger triggers, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Cast the creature returned to your hand by paying its mana cost. 
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand with the first trigger and returning nothing with the second trigger.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2751-5116.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Gilded Lotus and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

790-1218-5919.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-1218-5919.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Razorkin Needlehead infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

4186-5783-5786.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creature tokens.
4186-5783-5786.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that has flying due to Toby.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 3.

4770-4772-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
4770-4772-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1881-3180-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Chamber Sentry on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

647-902-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have visited at least one Attraction this turn.
647-902-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squirrel Squatters as attackers.
Squirrel Squatters triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Squirrel token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-1849-2661.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gwenna.
1409-1849-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Gwenna by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gwenna enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Gwenna.
Repeat.

1029-2711.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
1029-2711.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library, then causing you to add {G} and gain 1 life for each nonland card revealed this way, then causing each player to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Selvala.
Repeat.
NOTE: If everyone would happen to reveal a land, Selvala makes no mana, and therefore you will need to supplement mana to pay for Tolarian Kraken's trigger if you have no mana in your mana pool.

1636-4006.description:
Intruder Alarm's first ability prevents creatures from untapping during their controller's untap step.
Because Hushbringer prevents abilities from triggering whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm's second ability does not trigger to untap them.

uses.n: Liliana, Heretical Healer // Liliana, Defiant Necromancer

136-2945-4050-4976.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cadaver Imp, adding {B}.
Cadaver Imp dies, triggering Open the Graves and Liliana, Heretical Healer.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Liliana, Heretical Healer trigger, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield transformed, and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Liliana, Defiant Necromancer's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it.
Liliana, Defiant Necromancer is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Liliana, Defiant Necromancer ability, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cadaver Imp enters the battlefield, returning Liliana, Heretical Healer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Zombie tokens, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Liliana, Heretical Healer by paying {1}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

518-2191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the indestructible creature.
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting the indestructible creature.
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Arcbond triggers, holding priority, activate the indestructible creature an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, redirecting all damage done this turn to the indestructible creature.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing damage to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 4 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the indestructible creature an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, redirecting all damage done to you and creatures you control to the indestructible creature.
Resolve the final Arcbond trigger, dealing infinite damage to all opponent and all creatures your opponent control.

1447-2034-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two nontoken Humans.
1447-2034-4013.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing all nontoken Humans, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Angel of Glory's Rise.
Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, exiling all Zombies and returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
